Method of Attack: Manually deploying ransomware payloads after reconnaissance
Gaining access through phishing emails or stolen/compromised Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) credentials
Disabling anti-malware and antivirus solutions before deployment
Encrypting files with a custom .pysa extension on Windows and Linux devices
Collecting and exfiltrating sensitive files including personally identifiable information (PII) and payroll tax information
Threatening to leak stolen data to force ransom payment
Discoverer: Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) Cyber Division
Indicators of Compromise: Custom .pysa file extension on encrypted files
Ransom note with organization's name, Pysa's Tor site link, and data leak site link
